memories.content: The user requires Rust library crates to define their error types using thiserror, and Rust binary crates to use anyhow for error handling, and never the reverse.

The user has been bitten twice by Rust crates using the wrong error-handling library for their crate kind (e.g. anyhow in a library, or thiserror in a binary), which is why they now require thiserror for libraries and anyhow for binaries.
